overall.verdict: Mobile dark is a coherent indigo system with real proof on receipts, but Home/Pay/Receive still talk more than they show, and the one-scale bar is applied to capacity diagrams and $10k rows while $25 payments vanish. Swap and Receive-bottom are the weak screens: empty state, clipped QR, and no visceral length.
priority_fixes: Enforce 1px=$50 on every money length (Home token, Hub bar, Pay overlay, Activity ±amounts, Receipt 25.00); min-mark at 2px; never draw full credit capacity as if it were the payment.
Delete repeated numbers: Home legend + Instant line + account captions; Pay Arrives/Delivery/Route; Receive SHARE essay.
One receipt sheet (PAID/RECEIPT) with Frame, Proof, runtime verification; reuse it from Pay and Activity; scrim the world behind it.
Receive: sticky title, uncropped QR, hide capacity bar at 0.00, one copy CTA; Entity id truncated.
Swap: quote or explicit empty, drop header network chrome, draw the 100 USDC bar, don’t leave a disabled CTA over a blank half-screen.
